title: Add skill contract lint script for inheritance and output rules
description:
Problem: skill markdown contracts can drift over time, especially inheritance declarations and required output sections. Manual checks are inconsistent and expensive in tokens during review passes.

Desired outcome: add a lightweight verifier that enforces key skill contract rules and can run in local validation.

Scope:
- In scope: add Scripts/Test-SkillContracts.ps1.
- In scope: verify implementation-oriented skills include task-core-loop inheritance text.
- In scope: verify user-invocable skills include an explicit output section.
- In scope: produce actionable failure messages suitable for CI/local use.
- Out of scope: semantic NLP linting of all prompt text.

Validation:
- Positive run against current skills baseline.
- Negative smoke case proving the script fails when a required section is removed.

Confidence target: 90%.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created from self-review pass to make skill inheritance and output contract drift detectable by script instead of manual review.
